name: spec-drift
description: Manual check: does the code still match the spec we wrote before building?

then.prompt: Read .kiro/specs/switchpoint/design.md and requirements.md, then read the current contents of lib/ and app/. Report every place the code has drifted from the spec: missing requirements, changed formulas, numbers that do not trace to .kiro/steering/mass-save-rules.md, and any new feature that is not in tasks.md. Output a short list of gaps, largest first. Do not change code in this run.
